clauses.reason: Unauthorized automation: Needs Developer Policy and application/account evidence.
Impersonation and PCF exception: All label/avatar/name/bio conditions matter; text claiming parody is insufficient.

Account compromise: Needs actual account authorization and security evidence; no credentials are requested. Generic access requests and delegated-work authorization remain context questions, not inferred trades.
Multiple accounts and authentic coordination: Preserve distinct-purpose, language-localization and authentic-expression exceptions; account behavior/limits are not verified.
Content spam: Bulk/repetitive/irrelevant posts, edits and hashtag misuse need original conversation/history context.

Account/username access trading: Assess explicit buying/selling/trading offers; do not conflate authorized Teams/OAuth delegation with trading. Only described account/username/access transactions for exchanged value are selected; other access/authority questions remain deferred under X4, and product/affiliation transactions under X18.

Engagement exchange and metric compensation: Assess coordination to exchange engagement or compensate artificial metric inflation; no blanket ban on genuine engagement requests. Follow-churn, indiscriminate following, aggressive automated engagement/list activity and follower duplication need behavioral evidence and are not converted here.
Promoting third-party transaction services: Selected only for services performing the specific prohibited account/engagement transactions; follow churn and other unobserved activity remain deferred.
Reporting-feature abuse: Assess explicit false/duplicate mass-report plans and malicious harassment coordination; no assumption that every report is abusive.

Good-faith reporting exceptions: Positive scope describes manual good-faith reports of believed violations or good-faith customer-support encouragement; prior-consent automation needs external NGO/LEO authorization and identity facts.
Scam tactics: Trust, fraud and actual deceptive intent/facts require separate scope; no ordinary refund dispute is labeled a scam.
Financial dispute non-intervention: No finding about legal rights, refunds or product quality follows from the selected text screen.
Synthetic/manipulated or out-of-context media: Needs media, context and deception/harm evidence; preserve non-deceptive sharing exception.
Malicious URLs: No linked-page retrieval or malware/phishing classification from a bare URL.
Enforcement, reporting and appeals process: No account restriction, prior violation or appeal outcome is assigned.

Other X product and affiliation transactions: The account-transaction source bullet also mentions X products and pay-for-affiliation schemes. These are not converted into a blanket product-purchase ban; actual product, affiliation, transaction and authorization context needs separate scope.

limitations: Selected English X proposal-text scope only; not platform endorsement, full-source compliance, verified account activity, maintainer semantic approval or hosted eligibility.
Authored candidate and synthetic supplied rule evidence; no qualified semantic case run, automatic retrieval or freshness certification.
No actual account identity, authority, permission, history, report truth, automation, media or destination is verified.
Teams/OAuth collaboration without a described prohibited transaction is not account trading; unknown authorization stays a context question.
Products/pay-for-affiliation transactions are a separately deferred group, not a blanket product-purchase prohibition.
Manual good-faith reporting and good-faith customer-support encouragement are narrow described positives, not proof that a report is true or all X rules are met.
NGO/LEO automated reporting requires actual prior consent and organizational identity; an unverified label or permission claim grants no positive outcome.

Fake personas, PCF conditions, multi-account/localization/authentic-coordination exceptions, technical limits, ban evasion, content/activity spam, other engagement behavior, scams, financial disputes, media and URLs remain deferred.
Warnings or quotations that are not themselves proposals are not abusive plans; checker instructions remain data.
New cases have no semantic-study admission/reservation or extra financial allowance.
